suite: V2.11 actual-source governance and queue interactions

results.name: Work prioritizes the acting person’s scoped due actions and retains explicit team filters
Work filters and exact action links preserve source decisions and completed outcomes
Inbox priority follows unresolved due work; read and acknowledgement do not resolve it
Notification source actions open the exact task and reject recipient or source changes
Follow-ups reuse exact existing actions and reject resolved sources during preparation
Role comparison uses canonical deny precedence without changing live access
Reviewed role apply checks actual administrator, full preview and source freshness
A reviewed role applies through the canonical command and retains immutable system guards
Opening another role or policy preserves the unfinished singleton draft
Assignment preview is nonmutating and applies only on the reviewed second step
Access review rejects stale state and provides a dated renewal for expired assignments
Direct-rule preview preserves independent actor checks and separation of duties
Draft escalation compares weekend clocks and real fallback without changing saved policy
Escalation tests respect stop semantics, missing fallback and stale draft results
File approval preparation shows actionable routing and source blockers without submitting
Refreshing a stale approval draft binds current source and preserves review instructions
Real file approval retains origin, requires explicit decision and preserves canonical byte checks
Pending withdrawal cannot be committed after identity changes inside its dialog
Rendered interaction routes expose registered actions and useful scoped missing-record states
